# Playwright 1.64.1 adds a disabled feature our launch-args copy lacks

## Context

Dependabot PR #19859 (five dev-dependency updates) is red on one unit arm, the same way on all three attempts ([run 39218250707](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/39218250707)). The failing test is `test/playwright/unit/e2e/glState.spec.mjs` › "#19675 every launch profile keeps Playwright's disabled features in its one --disable-features", assertion `the copy matches the installed Playwright`: it expected `AvoidCorsURLLoaderRestartOnRedirect` and the copy has no such entry. The other 54 checks are green.

## The Problem

Playwright 1.64.1 adds `AvoidCorsURLLoaderRestartOnRedirect` to its `disabledFeatures`. That is its fix for microsoft/playwright#43242: Chromium 155 aborts preflighted cross-origin redirects while Fetch interception is enabled. Chrome keeps only the last `--disable-features`, and our launch profiles pass one after Playwright's. So `PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES` has to repeat Playwright's list, or our E2E browser quietly turns the feature back on. The guard caught the drift, which is what it is for. Because the copy must equal the installed Playwright, the copy update and the bump have to land together. Neither one can land on `dev` alone.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/utils/gpuIntent.mjs` — `PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES` ("copied verbatim from its `chromiumSwitches`"). `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` combines it with our three features into one `--disable-features`.
- `test/playwright/unit/e2e/glState.spec.mjs` — the #19675 arm reads the installed `playwright-core/lib/coreBundle.js` list and requires equality.
- Design authority: the `PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES` JSDoc: "`glState.spec.mjs` fails when the installed Playwright's list stops matching." The copy exists because of the #19675 measurement: a list of ours re-enabled Playwright's disabled storage partitioning. The same work measured `--overscroll-history-navigation=0` as dead, so dropping our own `--disable-features` is not an option.
- `package.json` declares `"@playwright/test": "^1.63.0"`, so only `package-lock.json` moves: `@playwright/test`, `playwright` and `playwright-core` go to 1.64.1.
- Upstream at v1.64.1 (`packages/playwright-core/src/server/chromium/chromiumSwitches.ts`): the one addition comes right after `BlockOriginHeaderModificationOnRedirect`.

## The Fix

One PR: move the lock to Playwright 1.64.1 (`npm update @playwright/test`, lock only), and add `'AvoidCorsURLLoaderRestartOnRedirect'` to `PLAYWRIGHT_DISABLED_FEATURES` after `'BlockOriginHeaderModificationOnRedirect'`, the position upstream gives it. After the merge, Dependabot rebases #19859 down to its other four updates (js-yaml, mermaid, sass, webpack), and the automerge workflow merges them on green.

The fix does not go onto Dependabot's branch: the reusable automerge decision refuses any sender but Dependabot, so a foreign push would turn #19859 into a manual merge carrying agent code.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `package-lock.json` resolves `@playwright/test`, `playwright` and `playwright-core` to 1.64.1, and nothing else moves.
- [ ] The #19675 arm passes against the installed 1.64.1. It is red with `dev`'s copy and 1.64.1 installed (#19859's run), green at head.
- [ ] The unit job and the E2E jobs pass at head.
- [ ] Post-merge validation: #19859 rebases to four updates, goes green and auto-merges.

## Out of Scope

- Changing the copy-plus-drift-test design. Deriving the list at config load from the installed bundle, the way the spec already does, would make future list changes free. That is the call of #19675's owner, and this ticket works with either design.
- js-yaml, mermaid, sass and webpack: they stay in #19859.
